Poss-SLPC sro Launches New High-Strength Steel Product for Construction Sector

Slovak steel manufacturer Poss-SLPC sro has announced the launch of a new high-strength steel product designed for the construction industry, marking a significant addition to its portfolio of advanced materials. The company unveiled the product, named PossForm 710, at an industry event in Košice on Tuesday, drawing interest from regional contractors and suppliers.

PossForm 710 is engineered to meet the increasing demand for lighter yet stronger structural materials in both commercial and infrastructure projects. According to the company, the new steel grade offers a yield strength of 710 megapascals, significantly above the European average for standard construction steel. Poss-SLPC sro executives highlighted the product’s weldability and corrosion resistance, positioning it as a solution for both cost savings and sustainability.

“In recent years, our customers have been asking for materials that help them reduce weight without compromising on safety,” said Marek Hruška, Poss-SLPC sro’s Director of Product Development. “PossForm 710 answers that need. It’s the result of three years of R&D and close cooperation with Slovak construction firms.”

Industry analysts describe the launch as a timely move, given Slovakia’s ongoing investments in infrastructure and the broader Central European trend toward taller, more complex buildings. “The market is shifting toward steel solutions that enable faster assembly and longer lifespans,” noted Jana Kováčová, a steel sector analyst at the Bratislava-based Institute for Industrial Policy. “Poss-SLPC’s new product arrives as construction companies face both higher steel prices and tighter project schedules.”

The Slovak Association of Construction Contractors welcomed the news, citing the potential for domestic steelmakers to contribute more to local supply chains. “We are pleased to see innovation coming from within Slovakia,” said association spokesperson Andrej Polák. “Products like PossForm 710 can help our members offer more competitive bids on European projects.”

Poss-SLPC sro reports that PossForm 710 has already passed certification under EN 10025-6, the European standard for high-strength structural steels. The company said that initial production will focus on sheet and plate formats, with deliveries to leading Slovak and Czech construction firms starting in July. Poss-SLPC sro anticipates expanding capacity if demand continues to rise, and is in talks with several regional distributors to ensure broad market coverage by the end of the year.
